title: civikitchen profile
description: Canonical shape of docker/profiles/<name>/profile.json — the declarative description of a civikitchen scenario (extensions, authx, API users, and declarative content). This is the single source of truth for the format; any tool that reads or writes these profiles validates against this schema.

description.description: One-line human summary of the scenario.

include.description: Profiles applied before this one, by name; the applying tool resolves them as it resolves a selected profile. Includes nest depth-first, every profile applies once, and a cycle is an error.

apiUsers.description: API users asserted after install (idempotent by username); credentials are supplied or issued by the applying tool, never stored in the profile.

dependencies.description: Extensions the scenario needs. Applied in array order (deps before dependents).

snapshot.description: Generate this profile's data once and restore it from a stored database snapshot on later fresh boots, with every date shifted to today. Generators date records relative to CK_SEED_TODAY and size them by CK_SEED_SIZE. Restored on the standalone image only; elsewhere the profile applies as without this block.

calendar.description: The coarsest calendar period the data relies on ("last year", "this month"). A snapshot is valid only while today lies in the period it was generated in; none means relative day windows only.

sizes.description: The CK_SEED_SIZE values the generators support. Default: ["demo"].

after_restore.description: PHP scripts run as the admin user after a restore, in list order and in one process, e.g. jobs that fill reporting tables. Paths are relative to the profile file's directory and must stay inside it.

dependency.description: One extension. Source is git (`repo` + `version`), the civicrm.org registry (`registry: true`), or core-bundled (neither — enable only).

repo.description: Git URL — cloned at `version` into the site's ext dir.

registry.description: true = fetch a packaged release from the civicrm.org registry (cv ext:download).

version.description: Git ref (tag/branch/commit) to check out. Only meaningful with `repo`.

enable.description: Enable the extension after install (cv ext:enable). Absent/false = fetch only.

skip.description: Leave this extension unmanaged: never auto-install, update, or remove it. For locally-patched or manually-maintained extensions.

skipUf.description: Host CMS frameworks (CIVICRM_UF values) on which this extension is neither fetched nor enabled.

skipUfReason.description: Human-readable reason for skipUf, shown as a SKIP line in the boot log.

registry.description: Registry-sourced: no git repo or git version — the release picks its own version.

config.description: Instance configuration asserted on every apply (overwrite): whatever differs is written back, so drift is corrected each run. Applied after dependencies, before seed.

settings.description: CiviCRM Settings (Setting.set), asserted every run — e.g. environment: Staging (jobs refused + mail off). Applied first. enable_components is the whole list; config.components adds to it instead. An unknown setting is an error.

components.description: Core components switched on, additively: the others keep their state, so profiles combine. Applied after settings, before the rest. A name core does not know (CiviContribute, CiviMember, CiviEvent, CiviMail, CiviPledge, CiviCase, CiviReport, CiviCampaign) is an error.

from_email.description: Default from-address; replaces the fresh-install EXAMPLE.ORG placeholder.

ref.description: Stable handle to cross-link seed contacts to this group.

name.description: Machine name — the idempotent match key.

membership_types.description: Membership types asserted by name (idempotent), owned by the domain organization. Requires CiviMember and an existing financial type; either missing is an error.

name.description: Machine name — the idempotent match key.

financial_type.description: Financial type by name, e.g. Member Dues.

fixed_period_start_day.description: Start of a fixed period as MMDD, e.g. 101 for 1 January.

seed.description: Sample content created once and never overwritten (UI edits survive re-apply). A record is matched by its anchor, deleted ones included, so a trashed seed record is not recreated. Every missing prerequisite (unknown field, group, financial type, contact ref, disabled component) is listed and nothing is written.

contacts.description: Anchored fixture contacts, created with their primary email and group memberships. Any other APIv4 Contact field may be set as an extra property; an unknown one is an error.

ref.description: Doubles as external_identifier — the idempotent match key.

groups.description: Group refs (config.groups[].ref) or bare group names.

contributions.description: Contributions linked to seed contacts, created once. The anchor is trxn_id profile-seed-<ref>, or profile-seed-<contact_ref>-<n> (n = 1-based position in this list) without a ref. Requires CiviContribute. Any other APIv4 Contribution field may be set as an extra property; an unknown one is an error.

ref.description: Optional stable handle (used to build the idempotent trxn_id).

contact_ref.description: A seed.contacts[].ref, or the external_identifier of a contact that already exists.

financial_type_id:name.description: Financial type by name, e.g. Donation. A numeric financial_type_id is not accepted.

scripts.description: Imperative PHP scripts (run via `cv scr` as the admin user), applied in list order AFTER config and seed. The escape hatch for volume / complex fixtures that config/seed cannot express (a year of history, generated records, mandates). Each entry is a path relative to the profile file's directory and must stay inside it. Only listed files run; a seeds/ directory next to profile.json is an error. A consumer that only wants the declarative tier ignores it.

contentProfile.description: A standalone declarative content document (authx + apiUsers + config + seed + optional scripts) applied to an existing instance by another tool. A full profile embeds the same shape inline.

apiUsers.description: API users asserted after install (idempotent by username); credentials are supplied or issued by the applying tool, never stored in the profile.

authx.description: AuthX configuration for headless API access.

header_cred.description: Accepted credential flows in the Authorization header. Must include api_key or pass because CiviKitchen does not issue JWTs for generated users.

username.description: Cross-CMS login name. Delimiters and control characters are forbidden so the credentials record remains unambiguous.

role.description: CiviKitchen-owned CMS role machine name. The reserved prefix permits exact reconciliation without mutating unrelated site roles.

permissions.description: CiviCRM permission strings granted to the user's role.

apiUser.description: One API user: a CMS role carrying exactly these CiviCRM permissions and a user in it. The credential (api key) is never part of a profile — the applying tool supplies or issues it.
